prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached Japanese achievement badge design proposal. Preserve the exact 4-column 2-row layout, all Japanese names and text, ivory background, glossy rounded enamel pin aesthetic, colored rims, shadows, visual quality and scale.
Change ONLY the two badge designs specified below and the matching pale unearned-state sample. Keep the other FIVE badges unchanged, including the turtle holding the net, dolphin with book, 100-point star, hermit holding the magnifier, and metal tongs rosette.
CONCEPT OF THE GAME: a cheerful children's exploration team sorts beach litter and raises cute marine companion pets. Exploration means discovering and caring together through litter sorting, not a race to a finish flag.
1. TOP-LEFT "はじめのいっぽ賞": completely replace the current footprint island design. Create a simple readable new exploration-team FIRST CLEANUP badge, a softly rounded expedition-patch silhouette with an ivory-and-gold edge. Main action: one cute small blue dolphin companion wearing a tiny tan explorer cap, smiling and placing one BLUE plastic bottle into the matching BLUE sorting box using its flipper. Bottle halfway above the opening so the action is unmistakable. Beside that blue box is ONE smaller CORAL sorting box marked with a simple ivory CAN pictogram. The BLUE box is marked with an ivory BOTTLE pictogram, not recycling arrows or letters, and that pictogram matches the bottle in the dolphin's flipper. The two different sorting categories must be visually clear; no mixed rubbish spilling out. A SMALL coral triangular expedition-team pennant behind the dolphin has a tiny ivory seashell emblem, NOT a start/finish race flag. Keep the flag a minor accent. A thin aqua wave along the bottom connects to the marine setting. The dolphin, correct sorting action and two boxes are the principal simple shapes. No human footprints, no sandy trail, no island scenery, no human characters, no extra creatures, no long text inside the badge. Cute energetic beginner team feeling. Colors: aqua, warm sand/tan, coral and ivory. All contained cleanly within the card. Match the existing dolphin's round face, blush and blue/white coloring.
2. BOTTOM ROW THIRD CARD "そだておや賞": retain mint heart-shaped frame, ivory/gold outline and the same three cute pets, but RECOMPOSE them to ENCIRCLE A CENTRAL PINK HEART. The pink heart must be large, centered in the medallion and fully readable, about 30% of its inner width. Arrange the BLUE DOLPHIN at upper-left (10 o'clock), MINT SEA TURTLE at upper-right (2 o'clock), and PEACH HERMIT CRAB at bottom-center (6 o'clock). They form a balanced triangle AROUND the heart, with the heart in the open center; do not cluster all animals to the right or put the heart below the animals. Each pet looks inward happily and reaches a flipper or pincer to one different edge of the central heart, gently holding it together. Keep all THREE faces clearly visible, turtle shell and crab spiral shell visible. Crab is BELOW the heart, not lower-right. Pink heart is above crab and between dolphin and turtle. No face may be covered by the heart. No fourth animal or extra heart. Warm affectionate cheerful expressions, concise large silhouettes.
3. BOTTOM-RIGHT unearned sample: replace its old footprint-island art with a pale pastel ghost version of the NEW explorer-dolphin + sorting boxes badge from top-left. Preserve exact captions "あと すこし！", "できたら いろが つくよ", dotted border and progress bar.
Keep these exact unchanged title names under each card: はじめのいっぽ賞 / プラごみハンター賞 / うみはかせ賞 / クイズまんてん賞 / ゴミたんてい賞 / ひろいもの名人賞 / そだておや賞. All header/footer text unchanged. High fidelity edit; proposal only.
